Exception: CurrencyCode/CurrencyName are LiteralKit unions over the generated ISO 4217 enumeration; example-based assertions cover representative decode/reject and `.Options` membership, and S.toArbitrary over a finite literal union only re-samples already-enumerated members, so schema-derived property coverage would be vacuous.

Exception: meta-test of the Fn/ThunkOf/AnyFn schema combinator over function values (declareConstructor with self-identity equivalence); no structural data for S.toArbitrary to generate or round-trip.

Exception: PromiseSchema is a pure S.declare<globalThis.Promise<unknown>> identity declaration (Type === Encoded === a native Promise, no codec transform). S.toArbitrary throws 'Unsupported AST Declaration', and a Promise cannot be meaningfully round-tripped (decode/encode are identity, equivalence is reference equality), so any property law would be vacuous. Cross-realm acceptance and thenable-impostor rejection are covered by example-based unit tests.

Exception: TerritoryCode/TerritoryName and their code<->name MappedLiteralKit codecs are finite literal-union schemas over the generated CLDR enumeration; representative decode/encode and reversible-mapping cases are covered by example assertions, and S.toArbitrary over the finite enumeration adds no coverage beyond the enumerated members.

Exception: Timezone is a LiteralKit union over the generated IANA tzdb enumeration; example-based assertions cover representative decode and rejection, and property sampling over a finite literal union only re-picks already-enumerated members, so schema-derived property coverage would be vacuous.
Exception: meta-test of the destructiveTransform combinator using test-local illustrative schemas; lossy decode + passthrough encode has no round-trip law and no domain source schema.
